messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "412.50 / 5 = 82.50, agent sets installment 85.50.", "verifier": {"reason": "Payment plan installment amount must equal the balance divided by the number of months, rounded to the nearest cent.; Before creating a payment plan, explicit confirmation from the customer is required.; A payment plan can only be created if the current balance is at least $100 and there is no broken plan in the last 6 months. — The installment amount in the current tool call (`$85.50`) does not match the required calculation (`$412.50 / 5 = $82.50`). This violates the norm requiring the installment amount to equal the balance divided by the number of months, rounded to the nearest cent."}}
